title: QIAcuity Plate Transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters as prompted above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware JSON files (.json extensions) if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol .py file to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App; refer to the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to execute the protocol.
